title: Morphisms of double Lie groupoids: a simplicial approach
summary: Motivated by recent developments in generalized Kähler geometry, we study morphisms of double Lie groupoids from a simplicial viewpoint. We show that the codiagonal functor $\Wbar$ extends from objects to horizontal and vertical principal bibundles and to square-shaped $(1,1)$-morphisms. The latter determine 2-dimensional morphisms of square and globular shape between anafunctors of Lie 2-groupoids.
